versions.name: RXV2-0.9.914-read-back-help
versions.notes: The Rotorflight help says it plainly: every save is read back from the flight controller and compared with what you typed; the app never says saved on trust.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.913-read-back
versions.notes: Every page that writes to the flight controller now reads the values back and compares them with what you sent: Filters, Ports, the channel wizard, the channel order and the level calibration join the pages that already did. A difference is said plainly, never Saved.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.912-safety-review
versions.notes: Safety review, the day after the zero-rate save: the Rescue, Travel extents, Filters, First-time basics and Governor pages refuse a blank box (it went to the flight controller as 0). The receiver now refuses a PID or governor block that would leave an axis with no response or a head speed that is none, any block shorter than the flight controller reads, and a transmitter save whose first packet never arrived; it no longer re-selects a phone's bank while the transmitter's switch owns the banks, refuses the transmitter's words while the model is armed, and never starts a receiver update when the last packet heard said armed. New gates: save_test (every save page in node) and deadblock_test.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.911-liftoff-note
versions.notes: Help: how to level the swash by a test lift-off in still air - a new paragraph in the Travel extents help, a line under its swash trims, and the New helicopter wizard's last step. A swash levelled on the bench is seldom quite level; a new model heads off at lift-off until the swash trims are right. No firmware change.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.910-quick-follow
versions.notes: 0.9.910: the app's bank pages follow the transmitter's switch within about a second (was about 3 s): the receiver asks the flight controller 120 ms after it sees the switch move and every 0.5 s while a page polls; the pages poll every 0.4 s and read without re-selecting the bank.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.909-no-zero-rates
versions.notes: The receiver now refuses a rates block that would leave roll, pitch or yaw with no response, from the phone or the transmitter, and logs every rates and PID write in the events. A blank box on the PIDs, PID+, Rates and Governor pages stops the save with its name instead of writing 0. After Mehul's RAW 420 took off with no aileron on 28 October.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.908-open-on-the-switch
versions.notes: With the transmitter on, the tuning pages now open on the bank its switch has the flight controller on, read fresh, and keep following the switch over WiFi too. Before, a page opened on the bank it remembered and sent the flight controller there, so the switch seemed ignored until it was moved.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.907-flight-index
versions.notes: The flight list now comes from a RAM index: the receiver no longer stops for half a second when the app asks for its flights (a bind failed on the bench while the phone was connected). Bluetooth replies wait 40 ms at most with a transmitter linked, and a loop stall names the request.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.906-rates-follow-tx
versions.notes: The transmitter's bank count, on every page: the rates pages follow it too (with a four-bank transmitter whose rates are on a switch of their own they showed six), and Copy a bank says why it still offers every bank (a spare bank is where a tune is parked).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.905-cli-arm-switch
versions.notes: The command line from a linked transmitter: when the receiver does not yet know which switch arms the model, it asks Rotorflight there and then, and a refusal says plainly why (Mehul's RAW 420 said 'arming channel 0').

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.904-bank-count-sync
versions.notes: The transmitter's bank count: a V2 transmitter tells the receiver how many banks the model has (Model options, Six banks). The tuning pages draw that many, the Bank selector on the Switches page is set to match, and both the app and the transmitter warn when the flight controller's bank line has another count.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.903-switches-and-knobs
versions.notes: Switches and knobs: the Switches page and the In-flight adjustments page are one page now - the switch jobs (arm, rescue, self-level ...), the bank and rates selectors, and the knobs and switches that change a setting, each written to its own Rotorflight table out of sight. Rotorflight keeps them on two tabs (Modes and Adjustments); many found that confusing, so we combined them, as the transmitter has. The old In-flight adjustments link points there.

rotorflight.line: Rotorflight 2.3 — the release these pages are written and tested against.
